en: initialism of постоя́нное ме́сто жи́тельства (postojánnoje mésto žítelʹstva): (place of) permanent residence (used in reference to people moving to another place/country, as opposed to those going for a visit)
initialism of Приднестро́вская Молда́вская Респу́блика (Pridnestróvskaja Moldávskaja Respúblika, “Pridnestrovian Moldavian Republic”) (PMR)
